'''Amir Kafshdar Goharshady''' ([[Persian language|Persian]]: امیر کفشدار گوهرشادی<ref>{{Cite web |last=SNN.IR |first=خبرگزاری دانشجو {{!}} |date=2018-12-19 |title=دانش‌آموخته دانشگاه یزد رتبه اول جشنواره خوارزمی را کسب کرد |url=https://snn.ir/fa/news/732764/%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%E2%80%8C%D8%A2%D9%85%D9%88%D8%AE%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%B4%DA%AF%D8%A7%D9%87-%DB%8C%D8%B2%D8%AF-%D8%B1%D8%AA%D8%A8%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%AC%D8%B4%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%87-%D8%AE%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B2%D9%85%DB%8C-%D8%B1%D8%A7-%DA%A9%D8%B3%D8%A8-%DA%A9%D8%B1%D8%AF |access-date=2025-12-31 |website=fa |language=fa}}</ref>) is a [[theoretical computer scientist]]. He is a Professor at the [[Gran Sasso Science Institute]]<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Computer Science / Faculty |url=https://www.gssi.it/people/professors/lectures-computer-science |archive-url=http://web.archive.org/web/20250911172421/https://www.gssi.it/people/professors/lectures-computer-science |archive-date=2025-09-11 |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=www.gssi.it |language=en-gb}}</ref> and the [[University of Oxford]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amir Goharshady |url=https://www.cs.ox.ac.uk/people/amir.goharshady/ |access-date=2025-12-30 |website=Department of Computer Science |language=en-gb}}</ref> and a fellow of [[St Catherine's College, Oxford]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Amir Goharshady |url=https://www.stcatz.ox.ac.uk/person/goharshady/ |access-date=2025-12-30 |website=St Catherine's College |language=en-GB}}</ref> He is known for his work in [[formal methods]], [[compilers]] and [[blockchain]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amir Goharshady |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=4o8gvAYAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2025-12-30 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=dblp: Amir Kafshdar Goharshady |url=https://dblp.org/pid/169/9728.html |access-date=2025-12-30 |website=dblp.org |language=en}}</ref> as well as his history in informatics and mathematical Olympiads.

== Education ==
Goharshady began university studies at the age of 16<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Un dipl&#244;m&#233; de l&#39;Universit&#233; de Yazd devient professeur associ&#233; &#224; l&#39;Universit&#233; d&#39;Oxford |url=https://yazd.ac.ir/6407-1306-8887 |access-date=2025-12-30 |website=yazd.ac.ir |language=fr-ca}}</ref> and obtained his [[undergraduate degree]]s in computer science and mathematics from the [[Yazd University|University of Yazd]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amir Goharshady |url=https://amir.goharshady.com/ |access-date=2025-12-30 |website=amir.goharshady.com |language=en-US}}</ref> and the [[University of London]]<ref name=":0" /> at the age of 19.<ref name=":1" /> He obtained his [[Master of Science|MSc]] from the [[Georgia Tech|Georgia Institute of Technology]]<ref name=":0" /> and completed his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in 2020 at the [[Institute of Science and Technology Austria]], supervised by [[Krishnendu Chatterjee]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amir Kafshdar Goharshady - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=270997 |access-date=2025-12-31 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref>.

== Career ==
Previously, he was an assistant professor of computer science and mathematics at [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology|HKUST]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amir KAFSHDAR GOHARSHADY {{!}} HKUST School of Engineering |url=https://seng.hkust.edu.hk/about/people/faculty/amir-kafshdar-goharshady |access-date=2025-12-31 |website=seng.hkust.edu.hk}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> In July 2024, he joined the [[University of Oxford]] as an associate professor of computer science.<ref>{{Cite web |title=New faculty appointments reinforce priority to expand world-leading teaching |url=https://www.cs.ox.ac.uk/news/2348-full.html |access-date=2025-12-31 |website=Department of Computer Science |language=en-gb}}</ref> He was promoted to professor and joined the [[Gran Sasso Science Institute|Gran Sasso Science]] Institute in 2026.<ref name=":2" /> He has served as a Program Committee Chair for several international conferences in [[blockchain]], including MARBLE<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2026 |editor-last=Leonardos |editor-first=Stefanos |editor2-last=Goharshady |editor2-first=Amir K. |editor3-last=Knottenbelt |editor3-first=William |editor4-last=Pardalos |editor4-first=Panos |title=Mathematical Research for Blockchain Economy |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-032-13377-9 |journal=Lecture Notes in Operations Research |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-032-13377-9 |issn=2731-040X}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Committee 2025 |url=https://www.marble-conference.org/committee-2025 |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=MARBLE |language=en}}</ref> and SETTA,<ref name="link.springer.com">{{Cite journal |date=2026 |editor-last=Goharshady |editor-first=Amir |editor2-last=Haase |editor2-first=Christoph |title=Dependable Software Engineering. Theories, Tools, and Applications |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-981-95-7826-9 |journal=Lecture Notes in Computer Science |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-981-95-7826-9 |issn=0302-9743}}</ref><ref name="link.springer.com"/><ref>{{Cite web |title=SETTA 2025 - Organisation |url=https://www.setta2025.uk/organisation |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=www.setta2025.uk |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=SETTA 2024 - Organization |url=https://setta2024.cs.cityu.edu.hk/organization.php |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=setta2024.cs.cityu.edu.hk}}</ref> as well as a Program Committee Member at [[AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence|AAAI]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=2026 Program Committee |url=https://aaai.org/conference/aaai/aaai-26/2026-program-committee/ |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=AAAI |language=en-US}}</ref> [[Symposium on Principles of Programming Languages|POPL]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=POPL 2027 |url=https://conf.researchr.org/home/POPL-2027 |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=conf.researchr.org}}</ref> [[TACAS]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=TACAS 2024 |url=https://etaps.org/2024/conferences/tacas/ |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=etaps.org |language=en}}</ref> [[Programming Language Design and Implementation|PLDI]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=PLDI conference series - PLDI 2026 |url=https://conf.researchr.org/series/pldi |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=conf.researchr.org}}</ref> [[Computer Aided Verification|CAV]],<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2024 |editor-last=Gurfinkel |editor-first=Arie |editor2-last=Ganesh |editor2-first=Vijay |title=Computer Aided Verification |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-031-65633-0 |journal=Lecture Notes in Computer Science |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-031-65633-0 |issn=0302-9743}}</ref> and [[European Symposium on Programming|ESOP]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=ESOP 2024 |url=https://etaps.org/2024/conferences/esop/ |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=etaps.org |language=en}}</ref> He is also a visiting professor at the [[IIT Bombay|Indian Institute of Technology Bombay]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Computer Science and Engineering. IIT Bombay |url=https://www.cse.iitb.ac.in/people/faculty |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=www.cse.iitb.ac.in}}</ref> and served as an advisor and trainer to the [[Pakistan]]i team at the [[International Olympiad in Informatics]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Reporter |first=The Newspaper's Staff |date=2025-08-15 |title=Students share experiences at Informatics Olympiad |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1930920 |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=Dawn |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=SundarSTEM School |url=https://sundarstem.edu.pk/faculty/dr.-amir-goharshady |access-date=2026-06-11 |website=sundarstem.edu.pk}}</ref>
